digest.component_or_area: code-review gate, project criterion routing system
propositions: The code-review extension seam is incomplete: project routing can merge but net-new LLM-backed project criteria are not dynamically fanned into Pass 1, resolved by the eval surface, or consulted through repository-aware routing in Pass 3
Criteria calibration erodes phase boundaries by moving severity, disposition, or fix instructions into the finder, causing pass overlap and hidden policy changes

The generic code-review project-criterion runtime seam must support dynamic fan-in, repository-effective Pass-3 routing, project eval/CLI resolution, and compatibility coverage with logical-to-physical id mapping

The project.review-phase-boundaries criterion must execute through all four passes with balanced eval corpus (RP-F1..RP-F6 and RP-N1..RP-N6) and remain advisory-only with block_threshold 0.90 and blocking_enabled false
Live Gerrit dogfooding must capture positive controls and invalid cross-phase directives as intermediate patchsets, then amend the violation before submission
